data.label: Synthetic services
data.description: Existing synthetic workload that emits structured logs and OpenTelemetry traces. Outside provisioning scope.

data.label: Log collection
data.description: Receives service logs. A Log Router sink exports the entries to Pub/Sub, so raw text never goes straight into the search store.

data.label: Trace collection
data.description: Collects OpenTelemetry spans. Span names and attributes are pulled into the redaction path before they are indexed.

data.label: Ingest queue
data.description: Buffers log and span records for redaction. A dead-letter topic keeps records that fail processing so they can be replayed.

data.label: Redaction worker
data.description: Masks secrets, tokens and personal data using Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) inspect templates, and keeps trace and span IDs as join keys. Fails closed: records that can't be redacted go to the dead-letter topic.

data.label: Redacted log & span store
data.description: Partitioned tables of redacted logs and spans, with search indexes for keyword and ID lookup. Retention is still to be decided.

data.label: Incident analysis service
data.description: Takes an incident time window, joins logs to spans by trace ID, and builds an evidence bundle where log text is quoted as untrusted data. It calls Gemini with no tools, checks that every citation is a real log or span ID, and returns an explanation with evidence or an abstention.

data.label: Analysis model
data.description: Reasons over redacted evidence only. The model ID, regional availability and quotas are not verified. Local tests use a scripted mock in place of this model.

data.label: Incident operator
data.description: Person who asks for an incident explanation through Identity-Aware Proxy and receives the cited answer. Outside provisioning scope.

brief.application: Use Google Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Correlate synthetic logs and distributed traces to explain a service incident. Include collection, redaction, storage/search, an AI analysis runtime and an operator-facing answer with source evidence. Treat log text as untrusted. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.first-gcp-sketch-log-trace-incident-explainer
decisions.title: First GCP sketch: log/trace incident explainer
decisions.context: Scope: collecting synthetic logs and traces, redacting them, storing and searching them in BigQuery, analysis on Cloud Run with Vertex AI Gemini, and an operator answer with cited evidence, protected by IAP. Assumptions: the region is still to be selected, model availability and quotas are not verified, and nothing is deployed. No typed GCP generator exists for this workload, so it remains an engineering gap.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Log and trace text is treated as untrusted data: it is clearly separated from model instructions, can never trigger tools or actions, and injection attempts are flagged.
needs.rationale: Attackers can write text into logs; if the model follows it, the incident explanation could be manipulated.

needs.statement: Sensitive values in logs are redacted before they are stored, indexed or sent to the model; the redaction policy is still a proposal.
needs.rationale: If raw secrets or personal data reach search storage or the model, they spread to places that are hard to clean up.
needs.basis: User asked to include redaction; diagram components redact and bq.

needs.statement: The analysis service correlates log entries with distributed-trace spans by trace and span ID for a given incident time window.
needs.rationale: Explaining an incident depends on linking errors to the requests and services they affected.
needs.basis: User: "Correlate synthetic logs and distributed traces to explain a service incident."
